title: Contain an OpenAI integration release
description: Select a change, complete evidence gates, choose retry and canary limits, then inject a failure. The outcome shows whether impact stays bounded.

changes.label: Model snapshot change
changes.detail: Same application contract, potentially different output behavior and latency.

changes.label: Responses API migration
changes.detail: Adapter changes typed items, storage settings, streaming events, and error mapping.

changes.label: New side-effecting tool
changes.detail: Adds model-proposed actions that must stay inside user authority and retry semantics.

changes.label: Retrieval policy change
changes.detail: Changes which evidence can enter context and how much is sent to synthesis.

gates.label: Contract tests
gates.detail: Validate item types, strict schemas, refusals, incomplete results, and unknown events.

gates.label: Task evals
gates.detail: Meet the reference quality floor overall and on critical slices.

gates.label: Safety evals
gates.detail: Test policy, prompt injection, sensitive data, and escalation behavior.

gates.label: Tool authorization
gates.detail: Derive identity from trusted state and require confirmation where impact is high.

gates.label: Idempotent actions
gates.detail: A retry with the same operation key cannot duplicate a side effect.

gates.label: Retrieval evals
gates.detail: Measure eligible-source recall, citation support, and cross-tenant exclusion.

gates.label: Load and rate limits
gates.detail: Verify latency, token, error, retry, and cost budgets at planned concurrency.

gates.label: Trace continuity
gates.detail: Link client, provider, retrieval, tool, retry, and fallback events.

gates.label: Warm rollback
gates.detail: Restore the prior configuration without depending on the candidate path.

failures.label: No injected failure
failures.detail: Evaluate whether the release evidence is sufficient for a small canary.
failures.signal: Candidate metrics remain inside their release thresholds.
failures.containment: Continue the bounded canary while watching stop conditions.

failures.label: Rate limit response
failures.detail: The provider rejects a request while shared token or request capacity is pressured.
failures.signal: Rate-limit rate rises and remaining-limit headers fall.
failures.containment: Back off with jitter, honor the deadline, and shed optional work.

failures.label: Timeout after tool execution
failures.detail: The action may have completed, but the caller did not receive the result.
failures.signal: The trace has a tool start but no acknowledged model continuation.
failures.containment: Look up the stable operation key before any retry.

failures.label: Schema validation failure
failures.detail: A candidate returns an item or field shape the adapter does not accept.
failures.signal: Contract-validation failures exceed the release threshold.
failures.containment: Do not parse loosely; route to fallback and block promotion.

failures.label: Safety slice regression
failures.detail: A critical abuse or high-risk slice falls below its reference floor.
failures.signal: Safety eval or online review rate crosses the stop condition.
failures.containment: Stop the canary, preserve evidence, and restore the reference configuration.
